name: Keran
title: Son of Dishon, a Horite clan leader
summary: Keran was one of the sons of Dishon, a Horite clan leader in the land of Seir. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the original inhabitants of the Edom region before the Esauites took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Horite genealogy
keyEvents.description: Keran is mentioned as one of the sons of Dishon in the genealogy of the Horites who lived in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Horite clan leaders
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Keran's family, were the original inhabitants of the Seir region before Esau's descendants displaced them.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Kera's lineage is confirmed in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of Dishan's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Horite Settlement in Se'ir
keyEvents.description: The Horites, to whom Kera's clan belonged, had established themselves in the mountainous region of Se'ir before Esau's descendants took over the area.
